A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SPP research. All 24 pages of each version, including experimental Appendix A and proof Appendix B, support comparison of the text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original transformer-pruning experiments for classification, image-text retrieval and LLM evaluation in Tables 1-5, plus latency measurements and structural analyses in Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains the original classification, retrieval, LLM-pruning, latency and structural-analysis results in the main text and Appendix A.

M1.justification: The pair-wise masks, differential-inclusion updates, solution-path pruning procedure and RIA-based LLM adaptation remain unchanged in Section 3 and Algorithms 1-2. Algorithm 1 is reformatted without changing its procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet-1k, CIFAR-10 and COCO, with C4 and WikiText2 for LLM calibration. Table 5 retains the same ARC-c, ARC-e, BoolQ, RTE and SST evaluations; no dataset or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1-2 retain their respective vision-pruning comparator sets, Table 4 retains DessiLBI, and Table 5 retains RIA and Wanda for both calibration datasets. Citation-format changes do not alter comparator membership.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A retain the model configurations, metrics, compression levels, calibration choices and training schedules. Tables 6 and 8 report identical settings, and the LLM comparisons remain at 50% sparsity.

E4.justification: The DessiLBI comparison in Table 4, mask-trajectory analysis in Figure 2 and layer/component sparsity analyses in Figures 3-4 are retained unchanged. No ablation, robustness test or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The statistical reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Corresponding results in Tables 1-5, 7 and 9 and Figures 2-4 match. For example, DeiT-Small SPP remains at 80.2% top-1 accuracy with 15.6M parameters, and Llama2-7B/SPP with C4 calibration retains 38.57% ARC-c accuracy.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, convergence results and proofs in Section 4 and Appendices A-B are unchanged. Equation numbering is adjusted: the Lyapunov definition moves from Equation 16 to Equation 15, with corresponding appendix references updated.

C1.justification: Both versions claim a transformer weight family spanning sparsity levels from one search stage, convergence to a critical point, and effective compression while preserving accuracy. The claimed potential for LLM pruning is also retained.

C2.justification: The interpretations of importance ordering, pair-wise compression and family consistency remain unchanged. Appendix A.2 retains the restriction concerning CNN architectures, and the conclusion retains the need for a more tailored LLM design.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and a GitHub repository link in the abstract; v1 provides no code-access pointer. Hardware, optimizer, hyperparameters and implementation descriptions in Appendix A remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the added access information, without verifying repository contents.

R1.justification: The reference lists contain the same works, and Sections 2 and A.2 retain the same positioning relative to transformer-pruning methods, mirror descent and DessiLBI. Changes concern citation formatting.

P1.justification: v2 standardizes citation punctuation and equation references, converts the contribution list to bullets, adds publication and corresponding-author details and acknowledgements, and removes a redundant opening sentence in Section 5.3. The substantive prose and section sequence remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 lightly redraws Figure 1, compacts Algorithm 1 and reformats and repositions the main tables, placing their captions above them. Table 1 moves out of the convergence discussion into the experimental pages. The same scientific displays are retained.

improvement.justification: The new code-access link gives readers an implementation pointer absent from v1. Citation cleanup and moving Table 1 out of the convergence discussion modestly improve usability. Methods, results, proofs and appendix details remain unchanged, so the improvement is limited to access information and presentation.
